text: ま…　おれさまには　かんけいの　ないこと　だけど！

structure.jp: おれさまには　かんけいの　ないこと　だけど！
structure.en: it's something that has nothing to do with me, though!

patterns.name: 〜のない
patterns.span: かんけいの　ないこと
patterns.explanation: In a description placed before a thing, の can stand in for が. かんけいの　ないこと = 'a matter that has no connection'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど at the end of a sentence trails off like 'though', softening or brushing off what was said. かんけいの　ないこと　だけど = 'not that it has anything to do with me, though'.
